verses.sloka: अथ तस्मिन्निमित्तानि दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः ।सुग्रीवं सम्परिष्वज्य तदा वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ६.४१.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: atha tasminnimittāni dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ ।sugrīvaṁ sampariṣvajya tadā vacanamabravīt ।। 6.41.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Rama, brother of Lakshmana, seeing the signs of war, embraced Sugriva and spoke these words.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्ड का चालीसवाँ सग पूरा हुआ । नकि Le ९०० A एकचत्वारशः सगः — 88 प्या Ne नि 0 अथ तस्मिन्निमित्तानि द्रा लक्ष्मएपू्व जः | सुग्रीवं सम्परिष्वज्य तदा बचनमत्रवीत्‌

verses.sloka: असम्मन्त्र्य मया सार्द्धं तदिदं साहसं कृतम् ।एवं साहसकर्माणि न कुर्वन्ति जनेश्वराः ।। ६.४१.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: asammantrya mayā sārddhaṁ tadidaṁ sāhasaṁ kṛtam ।evaṁ sāhasakarmāṇi na kurvanti janeśvarāḥ ।। 6.41.2 ।।।।

translations.english: "You have done this courageous feat without consulting me. Rulers do not do such actions."
translations.hindi: हे मित्र ! तुमने मुझसे परामशे किए बिना ही जैसे दुस्साहस का यह काम किआ है, वैला दुस्साहस को काम राजा लोगों को करना उचित नहीं

verses.sloka: संशये स्थाप्य मां चेदं बलं च सविभीषणम् ।कष्टं कृतमिदं वीर साहसं साहसप्रिय ।। ६.४१.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: saṁśaye sthāpya māṁ cedaṁ balaṁ ca savibhīṣaṇam ।kaṣṭaṁ kṛtamidaṁ vīra sāhasaṁ sāhasapriya ।। 6.41.3 ।।।।

translations.english: "O hero, who is fond of daring actions! To me, to the army and Vibheeshana you created a great doubt by this bold action of yours."
translations.hindi: हे साहसप्रिये ! हे वीर ! मुके, विभीषण को तथा समस्त बानरी सेना को चिन्ता में डाल, तुमने यह जोखों का काम किआ है

verses.sloka: इदानीं मा कृथा वीर एवंविधमचिन्तितम् ।त्वयि किञ्चित् समापन्ने किं कार्यं सीतया मम ।। ६.४१.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: idānīṁ mā kṛthā vīra evaṁvidhamacintitam ।tvayi kiñcit samāpanne kiṁ kāryaṁ sītayā mama ।। 6.41.4 ।।।।

translations.english: "O broad shouldered hero, tamer of foes! Do not do this kind of action. Even if you were harmed a bit, O destroyer of foes, of what use is it to me or even to Sita, Bharata, Satrughna or to Lakshmana or even to my body?"
translations.hindi: हे वीर ! इम प्रकार बिना समझे वूमे फिर कोई, काम मत करना । कहीं तुम्हारा कुछ भी अनभल हो जाता तो, सैं सीता को लेकर ही क्या करता!

verses.sloka: भरतेन महाबाहो लक्ष्मणेन यवीयसा ।शत्रुघ्नेन च शत्रुघ्न स्वशरीरेण वा पुनः ।। ६.४१.५ ।।पुनःपुनः ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bharatena mahābāho lakṣmaṇena yavīyasā ।śatrughnena ca śatrughna svaśarīreṇa vā punaḥ ।। 6.41.5 ।।punaḥpunaḥ ।।।।

translations.english: "O broad shouldered hero, tamer of foes! Do not do this kind of action. Even if you were harmed a bit, O destroyer of foes, of what use is it to me or even to Sita, Bharata, Satrughna or to Lakshmana or even to my body?"

verses.sloka: त्वयि चानागते पूर्वमिति मे निश्चिता मतिः ।जानतश्चापि ते वीर्यं महेन्द्रवरुणोपम ।। ६.४१.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tvayi cānāgate pūrvamiti me niścitā matiḥ ।jānataścāpi te vīryaṁ mahendravaruṇopama ।। 6.41.6 ।।।।

translations.english: "Mighty Sugriva! You resemble Indra and Varuna in might. Your valour is known to me. I have decided in my mind to kill the sons of Ravana and his relatives in battle, coronate Vibheeshana in Lanka, and hand over the kingdom to Bharata and give up my body."

verses.sloka: हत्वा ऽहं रावणं युद्धे सपुत्रबलवाहनम् ।अभिषिच्य च लङ्कायां विभीषणमथापि च ।भरते राज्यमावेश्य त्यक्ष्ये देहं महाबल ।। ६.४१.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hatvā 'haṁ rāvaṇaṁ yuddhe saputrabalavāhanam ।abhiṣicya ca laṅkāyāṁ vibhīṣaṇamathāpi ca ।bharate rājyamāveśya tyakṣye dehaṁ mahābala ।। 6.41.7 ।।।।

translations.english: "Mighty Sugriva! You resemble Indra and Varuna in might. Your valour is known to me. I have decided in my mind to kill the sons of Ravana and his relatives in battle, coronate Vibheeshana in Lanka, and hand over the kingdom to Bharata and give up my body."

verses.sloka: तमेवं वादिनं रामं सुग्रीवः प्रत्यभाषत ।। ६.४१.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamevaṁ vādinaṁ rāmaṁ sugrīvaḥ pratyabhāṣata ।। 6.41.8 ।।।।

translations.english: To Rama who was speaking in that manner, Sugriva replied, "Heroic Rama! Seeing that Ravana, who has borne away your consort, and knowing my own strength, how can I tolerate?"

verses.sloka: तव भार्यापहर्तारं दृष्ट्वा राघव रावणम् ।मर्षयामि कथं वीर जानन् पौरुषमात्मनः ।। ६.४१.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tava bhāryāpahartāraṁ dṛṣṭvā rāghava rāvaṇam ।marṣayāmi kathaṁ vīra jānan pauruṣamātmanaḥ ।। 6.41.9 ।।।।

translations.english: To Rama who was speaking in that manner, Sugriva replied, "Heroic Rama! Seeing that Ravana, who has borne away your consort, and knowing my own strength, how can I tolerate?"

verses.sloka: इत्येवं वादिनं वीरमभिनन्द्य स राघवः ।लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिसम्पन्नमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ६.४१.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ityevaṁ vādinaṁ vīramabhinandya sa rāghavaḥ ।lakṣmaṇaṁ lakṣmisampannamidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 6.41.10 ।।।।

translations.english: Raghava heard the hero Sugriva, applauding him and spoke these words to Lakshmana, who was endowed with prosperity.

verses.sloka: परिगृह्योदकं शीतं वनानि फलवन्ति च ।बलौघं संविभज्येमं व्यूह्य तिष्ठेम लक्ष्मण ।। ६.४१.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: parigṛhyodakaṁ śītaṁ vanāni phalavanti ca ।balaughaṁ saṁvibhajyemaṁ vyūhya tiṣṭhema lakṣmaṇa ।। 6.41.11 ।।।।

translations.english: "Lakshmana! We should occupy a region with cool water and good fruits and plan to divide the army and be ready."

verses.sloka: लोकक्षयकरं भीमं भयं पश्याम्युपस्थितम् ।निबर्हणं प्रवीराणामृक्षवानररक्षसाम् ।। ६.४१.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: lokakṣayakaraṁ bhīmaṁ bhayaṁ paśyāmyupasthitam ।nibarhaṇaṁ pravīrāṇāmṛkṣavānararakṣasām ।। 6.41.12 ।।।।

translations.english: "I foresee the terrific destruction of eminent heroes among Bears, monkeys and Rakshasas. I see the danger approaching."

verses.sloka: वाताश्च परुषा वान्ति कम्पते च वसुन्धरा ।पर्वताग्राणि वेपन्ते पतन्ति धरणीरुहाः ।। ६.४१.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vātāśca paruṣā vānti kampate ca vasundharā ।parvatāgrāṇi vepante patanti dharaṇīruhāḥ ।। 6.41.13 ।।।।

translations.english: "The winds are blowing severely, the earth is quaking in, the mountain peaks are shaking, and the elephants bearing the earth (in the four corners) are falling."

verses.sloka: मेघाः क्रव्यादसङ्काशाः परुषाः परुषस्वनाः ।क्रूराः क्रूरं प्रवर्षन्ति मिश्रं शोणितबिन्दुभिः ।। ६.४१.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: meghāḥ kravyādasaṅkāśāḥ paruṣāḥ paruṣasvanāḥ ।krūrāḥ krūraṁ pravarṣanti miśraṁ śoṇitabindubhiḥ ।। 6.41.14 ।।।।

translations.english: "The fierce clouds resembling wild birds are making terrible harsh sounds and rain mixed with drops of blood is showering."

verses.sloka: रक्तचन्दनसङ्काशा सन्ध्या परमदारुणा ।ज्वलच्च निपतत्येतदादित्यादग्निमण्डलम् ।। ६.४१.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: raktacandanasaṅkāśā sandhyā paramadāruṇā ।jvalacca nipatatyetadādityādagnimaṇḍalam ।। 6.41.15 ।।।।

translations.english: "The twilight appears like red sander trees, the burning fire falling from the sun is like a mass of fire and frightening."

verses.sloka: आदित्यमभिवाश्यन्ति जनयन्तो महद्भयम् ।दीना दीनस्वरा घोरा अप्रशस्ता मृगद्विजाः ।। ६.४१.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ādityamabhivāśyanti janayanto mahadbhayam ।dīnā dīnasvarā ghorā apraśastā mṛgadvijāḥ ।। 6.41.16 ।।।।

translations.english: "The desperate inauspicious sounds of ominous beasts crying pitifully facing the sun are causing great fear."

verses.sloka: रजन्यामप्रकाशश्च सन्तापयति चन्द्रमाः ।कृष्णरक्तान्तपर्यन्तो यथा लोकस्य सङ्क्षये ।। ६.४१.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rajanyāmaprakāśaśca santāpayati candramāḥ ।kṛṣṇaraktāntaparyanto yathā lokasya saṅkṣaye ।। 6.41.17 ।।।।

translations.english: "Like at the time of universal dissolution, the moon is not radiant, being surrounded by black and red halo at night and is tormenting."

verses.sloka: ह्रस्वो रूक्षो ऽप्रशस्तश्च परिवेषः सुलोहितः ।। ६.४१.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hrasvo rūkṣo 'praśastaśca pariveṣaḥ sulohitaḥ ।। 6.41.18 ।।।।

translations.english: "Lakshmana! Short dark spot observed in the Sun 's orbit is inauspicious. moon is surrounded by copper colour and dreary."

verses.sloka: आदित्यमण्डले नीलं लक्ष्म लक्ष्मण दृश्यते ।दृश्यन्ते न यथावच्च नक्षत्राण्यभिवर्तते ।युगान्तमिव लोकस्य पश्य लक्ष्मण शंसति ।। ६.४१.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ādityamaṇḍale nīlaṁ lakṣma lakṣmaṇa dṛśyate ।dṛśyante na yathāvacca nakṣatrāṇyabhivartate ।yugāntamiva lokasya paśya lakṣmaṇa śaṁsati ।। 6.41.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "Just as the spots on the moon, the stars are also dirty and not visible. It forebodes the end of the universe Lakshmana!"

verses.sloka: काकाः श्येनास्तथा गृध्रा नीचैः परिपतन्ति च ।शिवाश्चाप्यशिवा वाचः प्रवदन्ति महास्वनाः ।। ६.४१.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kākāḥ śyenāstathā gṛdhrā nīcaiḥ paripatanti ca ।śivāścāpyaśivā vācaḥ pravadanti mahāsvanāḥ ।। 6.41.20 ।।।।

translations.english: "The crows, hawks and also vultures are joining lowly animals like jackals and making loud noises which is inauspicious and not good."

verses.sloka: क्षिप्रमद्य दुराधर्षां लङ्कां रावणपालिताम् ।अभियाम जवेनैव सर्वतो हरिभिर्वृताः ।। ६.४१.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kṣipramadya durādharṣāṁ laṅkāṁ rāvaṇapālitām ।abhiyāma javenaiva sarvato haribhirvṛtāḥ ।। 6.41.21 ।।।।

translations.english: Surrounded on all sides by the vanaras, let us now march swiftly upon the impregnable Lanka ruled by Ravana.

verses.sloka: इत्येवं संवदन् वीरो लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः ।तस्मादवातरच्छीव्रं पर्वताग्रान्महाबलः ।। ६.४१.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ityevaṁ saṁvadan vīro lakṣmaṇaṁ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ ।tasmādavātaracchīvraṁ parvatāgrānmahābalaḥ ।। 6.41.22 ।।।।

translations.english: "The land will remain covered by rocks, tridents, swords hurled by the Vanaras and Rakshasas and with flesh and blood."

verses.sloka: अवतीर्यं च धर्मात्मा तस्माच्छैलात् स राघवः ।परैः परमदुर्धर्षं ददर्श बलमात्मनः ।। ६.४१.२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: avatīryaṁ ca dharmātmā tasmācchailāt sa rāghavaḥ ।paraiḥ paramadurdharṣaṁ dadarśa balamātmanaḥ ।। 6.41.23 ।।।।

translations.english: Mighty hero Rama, (the elder brother of Lakshmana) said to Lakshmana in this manner (as described earlier) and descended from the peak of the mountain without delay.

verses.sloka: सन्नह्य तु ससुग्रीवः कपिराजबलं महत् ।कालज्ञो राघवः काले संयुगायाभ्यचोदयत् ।। ६.४१.२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sannahya tu sasugrīvaḥ kapirājabalaṁ mahat ।kālajño rāghavaḥ kāle saṁyugāyābhyacodayat ।। 6.41.24 ।।।।

translations.english: Climbing down the mountain, the righteous Rama reviewed in his mind the strength of his army and the enemy which is difficult to assail.

verses.sloka: ततः काले महाबाहुर्बलेन महतावृतः ।प्रस्थितः पुरतो धन्वी लङ्कामभिमुखः पुरीम् ।। ६.४१.२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kāle mahābāhurbalena mahatāvṛtaḥ ।prasthitaḥ purato dhanvī laṅkāmabhimukhaḥ purīm ।। 6.41.25 ।।।।

translations.english: Raghava, who is knowledgeable of when to do what, motivated the army of Vanaras and Sugriva and ordered.

verses.sloka: तं विभीषणसुग्रीवौ हनुमान् जाम्बवान्नलः ।ऋक्षराजस्तथा नीलो लक्ष्मणश्चान्वयुस्तदा ।। ६.४१.२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ vibhīṣaṇasugrīvau hanumān jāmbavānnalaḥ ।ṛkṣarājastathā nīlo lakṣmaṇaścānvayustadā ।। 6.41.26 ।।।।

translations.english: Surrounded by a large army in front, the broad shouldered Rama proceeded towards Lanka.

verses.sloka: ततः पश्चात् सुमहती पृतनर्क्षवनौकसाम् ।प्रच्छाद्य महतीं भूमिमनुयाति स्म राघवम् ।। ६.४१.२७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ paścāt sumahatī pṛtanarkṣavanaukasām ।pracchādya mahatīṁ bhūmimanuyāti sma rāghavam ।। 6.41.27 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Vibheeshana, Sugriva, Hanuman, Jambavan, Nala, Neela in the same way Lakshmana followed.

verses.sloka: शैलशृङ्गाणि शतशः प्रवृद्धांश्च महीरुहान् ।जगृहुः कुञ्जरप्रख्या वानराः परवारणाः ।। ६.४१.२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śailaśṛṅgāṇi śataśaḥ pravṛddhāṁśca mahīruhān ।jagṛhuḥ kuñjaraprakhyā vānarāḥ paravāraṇāḥ ।। 6.41.28 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the bears, monkeys, covering all over the land went behind Rama.

verses.sloka: तौ तु दीर्घेण कालेन भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।रावणस्य पुरीं लङ्कामासेदतुररिन्दमौ ।। ६.४१.२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tau tu dīrgheṇa kālena bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।rāvaṇasya purīṁ laṅkāmāsedaturarindamau ।। 6.41.29 ।।।।

translations.english: The monkeys who were of the size of elephants capable of warding off the enemy, bore huge grown up trees in their hands and went.

verses.sloka: पताकमालिनीं रम्यामुद्यानवनशोभिताम् ।चित्रवप्रां सुदुष्प्रापामुच्चैः प्राकारतोरणाम् ।। ६.४१.३० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: patākamālinīṁ ramyāmudyānavanaśobhitām ।citravaprāṁ suduṣprāpāmuccaiḥ prākāratoraṇām ।। 6.41.30 ।।।।

translations.english: In a short while the two brothers Rama and Lakshmana, tamers of foes reached the city of Lanka.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार बानरराज सुग्रीव ने बल लगा कर, राक्षसराज | रावण को थका डाला और इस प्रकार त्रिजय रूपी कीर्ति प्राप्त कर, फिर सूर्यपुत्र सुमंब बिशाल आकाश को लॉघ कर, बानरों के बीच बैठे हुए श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के पाप श्रा पहुँचे २६ ॥ “९ क, (७ 2 इति स सबितृस्रनुस्तत्र तत्कमं कृत्वा पवनगतिरनीक प्राविशत्सम्प्रहष्टः । रघुवरनुपस्नोव॑ वन्य द्वह | तरुमृगगण मुख्यै;पूज्यमानो हीन्द्रः

verses.sloka: तां सुरैरपि दुर्धर्षां रामवाक्यप्रचोदिताः ।यथानिवेशं सम्पीड्य न्यविशन्त वनौकसः ।। ६.४१.३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ surairapi durdharṣāṁ rāmavākyapracoditāḥ ।yathāniveśaṁ sampīḍya nyaviśanta vanaukasaḥ ।। 6.41.31 ।।।।

translations.english: Commanded by Rama's words the Vanaras remaining in their positions as ordained, entered the wonderful Lanka, which was decorated with flags, embellished with gardens. The defensive walls and arches of the boundary of Lanka were difficult to access even for Devatas.

verses.sloka: लङ्कायास्तूत्तरद्वारं शलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् ।रामः सहानुजो धन्वी जुगोप च रुरोध च ।। ६.४१.३२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: laṅkāyāstūttaradvāraṁ śalaśṛṅgamivonnatam ।rāmaḥ sahānujo dhanvī jugopa ca rurodha ca ।। 6.41.32 ।।।।

translations.english: Commanded by Rama's words the Vanaras remaining in their positions as ordained, entered the wonderful Lanka, which was decorated with flags, embellished with gardens. The defensive walls and arches of the boundary of Lanka were difficult to access even for Devatas.

verses.sloka: लङ्कामुपनिविष्टश्च रामो दशरथात्मजः ।लक्ष्मणानुचरो वीरः पुरीं रावणपालिताम् ।उत्तरद्वारमासाद्य यत्र तिष्ठति रावणः ।। ६.४१.३३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: laṅkāmupaniviṣṭaśca rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ ।lakṣmaṇānucaro vīraḥ purīṁ rāvaṇapālitām ।uttaradvāramāsādya yatra tiṣṭhati rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.41.33 ।।।।

translations.english: Accompanied by his brother Lakshmana, Rama, armed with bow, blocked the northern gate of Lanka which was like a lofty mountain peak and protected.

verses.sloka: नान्यो रामाद्धि तद्द्वारं समर्थः परिरक्षितुम् ।रावणाधिष्ठितं भीमं वरुणेनेव सागरम् ।। ६.४१.३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nānyo rāmāddhi taddvāraṁ samarthaḥ parirakṣitum ।rāvaṇādhiṣṭhitaṁ bhīmaṁ varuṇeneva sāgaram ।। 6.41.34 ।।।।

translations.english: (Dasaratha's son) Rama who had Lakshmana as follower reached the northern gate protected by Ravana. Just as the ocean is guarded by Varuna, it was guarded by terrific Rakshasas, who were secretly hiding all over like the Rakshasas in the subterranean region with small amounts of numerous armours for protection. It was not possible for anyone other than Rama to enter.

verses.sloka: सायुधै राक्षसैर्भीमैरभिगुप्तं समन्ततः ।लघूनां त्रासजननं पातालमिव दानवैः ।। ६.४१.३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sāyudhai rākṣasairbhīmairabhiguptaṁ samantataḥ ।laghūnāṁ trāsajananaṁ pātālamiva dānavaiḥ ।। 6.41.35 ।।।।

translations.english: (Dasaratha's son) Rama who had Lakshmana as follower reached the northern gate protected by Ravana. Just as the ocean is guarded by Varuna, it was guarded by terrific Rakshasas, who were secretly hiding all over like the Rakshasas in the subterranean region with small amounts of numerous armours for protection. It was not possible for anyone other than Rama to enter.

verses.sloka: विन्यस्तानि च योधानां बहूनि विविधानि च ।ददर्शायुधजालानि तत्रैव कवचानि च ।। ६.४१.३६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vinyastāni ca yodhānāṁ bahūni vividhāni ca ।dadarśāyudhajālāni tatraiva kavacāni ca ।। 6.41.36 ।।।।

translations.english: (Dasaratha's son) Rama who had Lakshmana as follower reached the northern gate protected by Ravana. Just as the ocean is guarded by Varuna, it was guarded by terrific Rakshasas, who were secretly hiding all over like the Rakshasas in the subterranean region with small amounts of numerous armours for protection. It was not possible for anyone other than Rama to enter.

verses.sloka: पूर्वं तु द्वारमासाद्य नीलो हरिचमूपतिः ।अतिष्ठत् सह मैन्देन द्विविदेन च वीर्यवान् ।। ६.४१.३७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pūrvaṁ tu dvāramāsādya nīlo haricamūpatiḥ ।atiṣṭhat saha maindena dvividena ca vīryavān ।। 6.41.37 ।।।।

translations.english: Rama Saw there, numerous weapons of every kind so also shields for the combatants of war.

verses.sloka: अङ्गदो दक्षिणद्वारं जग्राह सुमहाबलः ।ऋषभेण गवाक्षेण गजेन गवयेन च ।। ६.४१.३८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgado dakṣiṇadvāraṁ jagrāha sumahābalaḥ ।ṛṣabheṇa gavākṣeṇa gajena gavayena ca ।। 6.41.38 ।।।।

translations.english: Neela the commanderinchief of the army of monkeys, a valiant one, also Dwivida, and Mainda reached the east gate and remained there.

verses.sloka: हनुमान् पश्चिमद्वारं ररक्ष बलवान् कपिः ।प्रमाथिप्रघसाभ्यां च वीरैरन्यैश्च सङ्गतः ।। ६.४१.३९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hanumān paścimadvāraṁ rarakṣa balavān kapiḥ ।pramāthipraghasābhyāṁ ca vīrairanyaiśca saṅgataḥ ।। 6.41.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Angada endowed with great prowess along with Rshaba, Gavaksha, Gaja, and Gavaya reached the south gate.

verses.sloka: मध्यमे च स्वयं गुल्मे सुग्रीवः समतिष्ठत ।सह सर्वैहरिश्रेष्ठैः सुपर्णश्वसनोपमैः ।। ६.४१.४० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: madhyame ca svayaṁ gulme sugrīvaḥ samatiṣṭhata ।saha sarvaihariśreṣṭhaiḥ suparṇaśvasanopamaiḥ ।। 6.41.40 ।।।।

translations.english: Mighty monkey Hanuman united with heroes Pramati and Praghasa and others protected the west gate.

verses.sloka: वानाराणां तु षट्त्रिंशत् कोट्यः प्रख्यातयूथपाः ।निपीड्योपनिविष्टाश्च सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः ।। ६.४१.४१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vānārāṇāṁ tu ṣaṭtriṁśat koṭyaḥ prakhyātayūthapāḥ ।nipīḍyopaniviṣṭāśca sugrīvo yatra vānaraḥ ।। 6.41.41 ।।।।

translations.english: Sugriva chief of all army and best of the monkey army who was equal to Garuda of beautiful wings, endowed with wind speed remained in the middle (of north and west) post.

verses.sloka: शासनेन तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणः सविभीषणः ।द्वारे द्वारे हरीणां तु कोटिं कोटिं न्यवेशयत् ।। ६.४१.४२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śāsanena tu rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ savibhīṣaṇaḥ ।dvāre dvāre harīṇāṁ tu koṭiṁ koṭiṁ nyaveśayat ।। 6.41.42 ।।।।

translations.english: Renowned generals of the Vanara army and thirtysix crores of Vanaras stood there camping.

verses.sloka: पश्चिमेन तु रामस्य सुग्रीवः सहजाम्बवान् ।अदूरान्मध्यमे गुल्मे तस्थौ बहुबलानुगः ।। ६.४१.४३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: paścimena tu rāmasya sugrīvaḥ sahajāmbavān ।adūrānmadhyame gulme tasthau bahubalānugaḥ ।। 6.41.43 ।।।।

translations.english: By the command of Rama, Vibheeshana accompanied by Lakshmana posted crores and crores of Vanaras there.

verses.sloka: ते तु वानरशार्दूलाः शार्दूला इव दंष्ट्रिणः ।गृहीत्वा द्रुमशैलाग्रान् हृष्टा युद्धाय तस्थिरे ।। ६.४१.४४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te tu vānaraśārdūlāḥ śārdūlā iva daṁṣṭriṇaḥ ।gṛhītvā drumaśailāgrān hṛṣṭā yuddhāya tasthire ।। 6.41.44 ।।।।

translations.english: Sushena along with Jambavan and a large army of Vanaras were posted in the centre not far from Rama at the west by Rama's order.

verses.sloka: सर्वे विकृतलाङ्गूलाः सर्वे दंष्ट्रानखायुधाः ।सर्वे विकृतचित्राङ्गाः सर्वे च विकृताननाः ।। ६.४१.४५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sarve vikṛtalāṅgūlāḥ sarve daṁṣṭrānakhāyudhāḥ ।sarve vikṛtacitrāṅgāḥ sarve ca vikṛtānanāḥ ।। 6.41.45 ।।।।

translations.english: Vanaras who resembled tigers, endowed with sharp teeth joyfully stood there holding trees and peaks of mountain waiting to combat.

verses.sloka: दशनागबलाः केचित् केचिद्दशगुणोत्तराः ।केचिन्नागसहस्रस्य बभूवुस्तुल्यविक्रमाः ।। ६.४१.४६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: daśanāgabalāḥ kecit keciddaśaguṇottarāḥ ।kecinnāgasahasrasya babhūvustulyavikramāḥ ।। 6.41.46 ।।।।

translations.english: All had their tails lifted unusually, had their nails and teeth sharp as weapons, some had unnatural face, and all of them had distorted eyes (as in fury).

verses.sloka: सन्ति चौघबलाः केचित् केचिच्छतगुणोत्तराः ।अप्रमेयबलाश्चान्ये तत्रासन् हरियूथपाः ।। ६.४१.४७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: santi caughabalāḥ kecit kecicchataguṇottarāḥ ।aprameyabalāścānye tatrāsan hariyūthapāḥ ।। 6.41.47 ।।।।

translations.english: A few of them were having the strength of ten elephants, some had ten times more than others, and a few were endowed with great strength equal to thousand elephants.

verses.sloka: अद्भुतश्च विचित्रश्च तेषामासीत् समागमः ।तत्र वानरसैन्यानां शलभानामिवोद्यमः ।। ६.४१.४८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: adbhutaśca vicitraśca teṣāmāsīt samāgamaḥ ।tatra vānarasainyānāṁ śalabhānāmivodyamaḥ ।। 6.41.48 ।।।।

translations.english: Few monkeys had strength of an ogha, some had a hundred times more, and the monkey commanders possessed immeasurable strength.

verses.sloka: परिपूर्णमिवाकाशं सञ्छन्नेव च मेदिनी ।लङ्कामुपनिविष्टैश्च सम्पतद्भिश्च वानरैः ।। ६.४१.४९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: paripūrṇamivākāśaṁ sañchanneva ca medinī ।laṅkāmupaniviṣṭaiśca sampatadbhiśca vānaraiḥ ।। 6.41.49 ।।।।

translations.english: There it seemed as if a flight of locusts had gathered, with monkey army gathered there. It was amazing and astonishing.

verses.sloka: शतं शतसहस्राणां पृथगृक्षवनौकसाम् ।लङ्काद्वाराण्युपाजग्मुरन्ये योद्धुं समन्ततः ।। ६.४१.५० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śataṁ śatasahasrāṇāṁ pṛthagṛkṣavanaukasām ।laṅkādvārāṇyupājagmuranye yoddhuṁ samantataḥ ।। 6.41.50 ।।।।

translations.english: Vanaras settled in such a way all around Lanka completely covering the land with those already at Lanka.

verses.sloka: आवृतः स गिरिः सर्वैस्तैः समन्तात् प्लवङ्गमैः ।। ६.४१.५१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: āvṛtaḥ sa giriḥ sarvaistaiḥ samantāt plavaṅgamaiḥ ।। 6.41.51 ।।।।

translations.english: A hundred thousand bars and monkeys and several others already gathered at the gates of Lanka to fight proceeded.

verses.sloka: अयुतानां सहस्रं च पुरीं तामभ्यवर्तत ।। ६.४१.५२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ayutānāṁ sahasraṁ ca purīṁ tāmabhyavartata ।। 6.41.52 ।।।।

translations.english: All over the mountain the monkeys surrounded the boundary wall of Lanka city to collect information.

verses.sloka: वानरैर्बलवद्भिश्च बभूव द्रुमपाणिभिः ।संवृता सर्वतो लङ्का दुष्प्रवेशापि वायुना ।। ६.४१.५३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vānarairbalavadbhiśca babhūva drumapāṇibhiḥ ।saṁvṛtā sarvato laṅkā duṣpraveśāpi vāyunā ।। 6.41.53 ।।।।

translations.english: Mighty Vanaras holding uprooted trees occupied everywhere and it seemed difficult for even wind to enter Lanka.

verses.sloka: राक्षसा विस्मयं जग्मुः सहसा ऽभिनिपीडिताः ।वानरैर्मेघसङ्काशैः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः ।। ६.४१.५४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasā vismayaṁ jagmuḥ sahasā 'bhinipīḍitāḥ ।vānarairmeghasaṅkāśaiḥ śakratulyaparākramaiḥ ।। 6.41.54 ।।।।

translations.english: Caught by Vanaras like clouds and equalled Indra in valour gave way to wonder for the Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: महान् शब्दो ऽभवत्तत्र बलौघस्याभिवर्ततः ।सागरस्येव भिन्नस्य यथा स्यात् सलिलस्वनः ।। ६.४१.५५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mahān śabdo 'bhavattatra balaughasyābhivartataḥ ।sāgarasyeva bhinnasya yathā syāt salilasvanaḥ ।। 6.41.55 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter with the divisions of the Vanara army moving like the ocean on the mountain peak, appeared like the roaring sound of water in the ocean moving out of boundary.

verses.sloka: तेन शब्देन महता सप्राकारा सतोरणा ।लङ्का प्रचलिता सर्वा सशैलवनकानना ।। ६.४१.५६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tena śabdena mahatā saprākārā satoraṇā ।laṅkā pracalitā sarvā saśailavanakānanā ।। 6.41.56 ।।।।

translations.english: By the great sound the boundary, the archways and the mountains and forests shook violently.

verses.sloka: रामलक्ष्मणगुप्ता सा सुग्रीवेण च वाहिनी ।बभूव दुर्धर्षतरा सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः ।। ६.४१.५७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāmalakṣmaṇaguptā sā sugrīveṇa ca vāhinī ।babhūva durdharṣatarā sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ ।। 6.41.57 ।।।।

translations.english: Protected by Rama and Lakshmana and Sugriva that an army of monkeys became difficult to assail even for Rakshasas and Devatas.

verses.sloka: राघवः सन्निवेश्यैव सैन्यं स्वं रक्षसां वधे ।सम्मन्त्र्य मन्त्रिभिः सार्धं निश्चित्य च पुनःपुनः ।आनन्तर्यमभिप्रेप्सुः क्रमयोगार्थतत्त्ववित् ।। ६.४१.५८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāghavaḥ sanniveśyaiva sainyaṁ svaṁ rakṣasāṁ vadhe ।sammantrya mantribhiḥ sārdhaṁ niścitya ca punaḥpunaḥ ।ānantaryamabhiprepsuḥ kramayogārthatattvavit ।। 6.41.58 ।।।।

translations.english: Deliberating on the action to be taken to kill the Rakshasas, Raghava himself called the army and gathered them and the ministers all of them again and again discussed and took the decision. Later recalling the king's duty with Vibheeshana, summoned Vali's son Angada and spoke these words.

verses.sloka: विभीषणस्यानुमते राजधर्मनुस्मरन् ।अङ्गदं वालितनयं समाहूयेदमब्रवीत् ।। ६.४१.५९ ।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇasyānumate rājadharmanusmaran ।aṅgadaṁ vālitanayaṁ samāhūyedamabravīt ।। 6.41.59 ।।

translations.english: Deliberating on the action to be taken to kill the Rakshasas, Raghava himself called the army and gathered them and the ministers all of them again and again discussed and took the decision. Later recalling the king's duty with Vibheeshana, summoned Vali's son Angada and spoke these words.

verses.sloka: त्य च पुनःपुनः ।गत्वा सोम्य दशग्रीवं ब्रुहि मद्वचनात् कपे ।लङ्घयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कां भयं त्यक्त्वा गतव्यथः ।। ६.४१.६० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tya ca punaḥpunaḥ ।gatvā somya daśagrīvaṁ bruhi madvacanāt kape ।laṅghayitvā purīṁ laṅkāṁ bhayaṁ tyaktvā gatavyathaḥ ।। 6.41.60 ।।।।

translations.english: Deliberating on the action to be taken to kill the Rakshasas, Raghava himself called the army and gathered them and the ministers all of them again and again discussed and took the decision. Later recalling the king's duty with Vibheeshana, summoned Vali's son Angada and spoke these words.

verses.sloka: भ्रष्टश्रीकगतैश्वर्य मुमूर्षो नष्टचेतन ।ऋषीणां देवतानां च गन्धर्वाप्सरसां तथा ।। ६.४१.६१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhraṣṭaśrīkagataiśvarya mumūrṣo naṣṭacetana ।ṛṣīṇāṁ devatānāṁ ca gandharvāpsarasāṁ tathā ।। 6.41.61 ।।।।

translations.english: "O noble Hanuman crossing over Lanka without fear, giving up the difficulties experienced earlier we reached. Admonish the tenheaded king who has lost senses, his past fortune and sovereignty."

verses.sloka: नागानामथ यक्षाणां राज्ञां च रजनीचर ।यच्च पापं कृतं मोहादवलिप्तेन राक्षस ।। ६.४१.६२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nāgānāmatha yakṣāṇāṁ rājñāṁ ca rajanīcara ।yacca pāpaṁ kṛtaṁ mohādavaliptena rākṣasa ।। 6.41.62 ।।।।

translations.english: "O night ranger! the time has come for punishment for the sins committed by you to the sages, Devatas, so also to Gandharvas, celestial beauties, Nagas, Yakshas and the kings because of your delusion in conceit. Surely your pride about the boons begotten from the selfborn creator will be gone, said Rama.

verses.sloka: नूनमद्य गतो दर्पः स्वयम्भूवरदानजः ।यस्य दण्डधरस्ते ऽहं दाराहरणकर्शितः ।दण्डं धारयमाणस्तु लङ्काद्वारे व्यवस्थितः ।। ६.४१.६३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nūnamadya gato darpaḥ svayambhūvaradānajaḥ ।yasya daṇḍadharaste 'haṁ dārāharaṇakarśitaḥ ।daṇḍaṁ dhārayamāṇastu laṅkādvāre vyavasthitaḥ ।। 6.41.63 ।।।।

translations.english: "O night ranger! the time has come for punishment for the sins committed by you to the sages, Devatas, so also to Gandharvas, celestial beauties, Nagas, Yakshas and the kings because of your delusion in conceit. Surely your pride about the boons begotten from the selfborn creator will be gone, said Rama.

verses.sloka: पदवीं देवतानां च महर्षीणां च राक्षस ।राजर्षीणां च सर्वेषां गमिष्यसि मया हतः ।। ६.४१.६४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: padavīṁ devatānāṁ ca maharṣīṇāṁ ca rākṣasa ।rājarṣīṇāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ gamiṣyasi mayā hataḥ ।। 6.41.64 ।।।।

translations.english: "O night ranger! the time has come for punishment for the sins committed by you to the sages, Devatas, so also to Gandharvas, celestial beauties, Nagas, Yakshas and the kings because of your delusion in conceit. Surely your pride about the boons begotten from the selfborn creator will be gone, said Rama.

verses.sloka: बलेन येन वै सीतां मायया राक्षसाधम ।मामतिक्रामयित्वा त्वं हृतवांस्तन्निदर्शय ।। ६.४१.६५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: balena yena vai sītāṁ māyayā rākṣasādhama ।māmatikrāmayitvā tvaṁ hṛtavāṁstannidarśaya ।। 6.41.65 ।।।।

translations.english: "You, who have abducted my wife, I will punish you with a rod of punishment. I am your chastiser, O king of Lanka I have taken position."

verses.sloka: अराक्षसमिमं लोकं कर्तास्मि निशितैः शरैः ।न चेच्छरणमभ्येषि मामुपादाय मैथिलीम् ।। ६.४१.६६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: arākṣasamimaṁ lokaṁ kartāsmi niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।na ceccharaṇamabhyeṣi māmupādāya maithilīm ।। 6.41.66 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Rakshasa! Even Devatas, sages and even royal sages have also lost their lives, killed by me."

verses.sloka: धर्मात्मा रक्षसां श्रेष्ठः सम्प्राप्तो ऽयं विभीषणः ।लङ्कैश्वर्यं ध्रुवं श्रीमानयं प्राप्नोत्यकण्टकम् ।। ६.४१.६७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: dharmātmā rakṣasāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ samprāpto 'yaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।laṅkaiśvaryaṁ dhruvaṁ śrīmānayaṁ prāpnotyakaṇṭakam ।। 6.41.67 ।।।।

translations.english: "O lowly Rakshasa! By deceiving me you took away Sita. Display that strength now."

verses.sloka: न हि राज्यमधर्मेण भोक्तुं क्षणमपि त्वया ।शक्यं मूर्खसहायेन पापेनाविदितात्मना ।। ६.४१.६८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na hi rājyamadharmeṇa bhoktuṁ kṣaṇamapi tvayā ।śakyaṁ mūrkhasahāyena pāpenāviditātmanā ।। 6.41.68 ।।।।

translations.english: "If you do not seek my protection I will devoid this world of Rakshasas with my sharp arrows."

verses.sloka: युद्ध्यस्व वा धृतिं कृत्वा शौर्यमालम्ब्य राक्षस ।मच्छरैस्त्वं रणे शान्तस्ततः पूतो भविष्यसि ।। ६.४१.६९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yuddhyasva vā dhṛtiṁ kṛtvā śauryamālambya rākṣasa ।maccharaistvaṁ raṇe śāntastataḥ pūto bhaviṣyasi ।। 6.41.69 ।।।।

translations.english: "This Vibheeshana, the best of Rakshasas will be glorious and fortunate undoubtedly having got the kingdom of Lanka."

verses.sloka: यद्वा विशसि लोकांस्त्रीन् पक्षिभूतो मनोजवः ।मम चक्षुष्पथं प्राप्य न जीवन् प्रतियास्यसि ।। ६.४१.७० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadvā viśasi lokāṁstrīn pakṣibhūto manojavaḥ ।mama cakṣuṣpathaṁ prāpya na jīvan pratiyāsyasi ।। 6.41.70 ।।।।

translations.english: "One who is not aware of himself, an unrighteous sinner ruling with foolish mates cannot enjoy the kingdom even for a moment."

verses.sloka: ब्रवीमि त्वां हितं वाक्यं क्रियतामौर्ध्वदैहिकम् ।सुदृष्टा क्रियतां लङ्का जीवितं ते मयि स्थितम् ।। ६.४१.७१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bravīmi tvāṁ hitaṁ vākyaṁ kriyatāmaurdhvadaihikam ।sudṛṣṭā kriyatāṁ laṅkā jīvitaṁ te mayi sthitam ।। 6.41.71 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Rakshasa! You are resorting to fortitude and valour and embracing gallantry in war. By my arrows you will obtain peace (in death)."

verses.sloka: इत्युक्तः स तु तारेयो रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ।जगामाकाशमाविश्य मूर्तिमानिव हव्यवाट् ।। ६.४१.७२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ityuktaḥ sa tu tāreyo rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā ।jagāmākāśamāviśya mūrtimāniva havyavāṭ ।। 6.41.72 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Ravana! You have no control over your mind, and if you come in the range of my eyesight and enter the three worlds also you will not go alive again."

verses.sloka: सो ऽतिपत्य मुहूर्तेन श्रीमान्रावणमन्दिरम् ।ददर्शासीनमव्यग्रं रावणं सचिवैः सह ।। ६.४१.७३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: so 'tipatya muhūrtena śrīmānrāvaṇamandiram ।dadarśāsīnamavyagraṁ rāvaṇaṁ sacivaiḥ saha ।। 6.41.73 ।।।।

translations.english: Having addressed it in well meaning words, Rama said 'I will do you obsequies as no one will be left in Lanka to do your last rites'.

verses.sloka: ततस्तस्याविदूरे स निपत्य हरिपुङ्गवः ।दीप्ताग्निसदृशस्तस्थावङ्गदः कनकाङ्गदः ।। ६.४१.७४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastasyāvidūre sa nipatya haripuṅgavaḥ ।dīptāgnisadṛśastasthāvaṅgadaḥ kanakāṅgadaḥ ।। 6.41.74 ।।।।

translations.english: Rama having spoken that way, Tara's son, Angada, who was like fire god, who was unwearied in action flew to the sky.

verses.sloka: तद्रामवचनं सर्वमन्यूनाधिकमुत्तमम् ।सामात्यं श्रावयामास निवेद्यात्मानमात्मना ।। ६.४१.७५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadrāmavacanaṁ sarvamanyūnādhikamuttamam ।sāmātyaṁ śrāvayāmāsa nivedyātmānamātmanā ।। 6.41.75 ।।।।

translations.english: Angada landed on Ravana's palace in a moment and saw the tiger like prosperous Ravana seated with his ministers.

verses.sloka: दूतो ऽहं कोसलेन्द्रस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः ।वालिपुत्रो ऽङ्गदो नाम यदि ते श्रोत्रमागतः ।। ६.४१.७६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: dūto 'haṁ kosalendrasya rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ।vāliputro 'ṅgado nāma yadi te śrotramāgataḥ ।। 6.41.76 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter, the leader of the monkeys, Angada adorned with golden armlets stood like a blazing fire at a distance.

verses.sloka: आह त्वां राघवो रामः कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः ।निष्पत्य प्रतियुद्ध्यस्व नृशंस पुरुषो भव ।। ६.४१.७७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: āha tvāṁ rāghavo rāmaḥ kausalyānandavardhanaḥ ।niṣpatya pratiyuddhyasva nṛśaṁsa puruṣo bhava ।। 6.41.77 ।।।।

translations.english: "I made known the words of Rama completely without adding or deleting. You may listen."

verses.sloka: हन्तास्मि त्वां सहामात्यं सपुत्रज्ञातिबान्धवम् ।निरुद्विग्नास्त्रयो लोका भविष्यन्ति हते त्वयि ।। ६.४१.७८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hantāsmi tvāṁ sahāmātyaṁ saputrajñātibāndhavam ।nirudvignāstrayo lokā bhaviṣyanti hate tvayi ।। 6.41.78 ।।।।

translations.english: "I am the son of Vali,by name Angada,an envoy of Rama ,the king of Kosala of unwearied action. You may know that I have landed"

verses.sloka: देवदानवयक्षाणां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् ।शत्रुमद्योद्धरिष्यामि त्वामृषीणां च कण्टकम् ।। ६.४१.७९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: devadānavayakṣāṇāṁ gandharvoragarakṣasām ।śatrumadyoddhariṣyāmi tvāmṛṣīṇāṁ ca kaṇṭakam ।। 6.41.79 ।।।।

translations.english: "Raghava, the enhancer of the happiness of Kausalya speaks to you. Ruthless Rakshasa! Sallying forth, get ready for combat."

verses.sloka: विभीषणस्य चैश्वर्यं भविष्यति हते त्वयि ।न चेत् सत्कृत्य वैदेहीं प्रणिपत्य प्रदास्यसि ।। ६.४१.८० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇasya caiśvaryaṁ bhaviṣyati hate tvayi ।na cet satkṛtya vaidehīṁ praṇipatya pradāsyasi ।। 6.41.80 ।।।।

translations.english: "You and your son's relatives and followers being killed (by me) the three worlds will be rid of fear of you."

verses.sloka: इत्येवं परुषं वाक्यं ब्रुवाणे हरिपुङ्गवे ।अमर्षवशमापन्नो निशाचरगणेश्वरः ।। ६.४१.८१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ityevaṁ paruṣaṁ vākyaṁ bruvāṇe haripuṅgave ।amarṣavaśamāpanno niśācaragaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 6.41.81 ।।।।

translations.english: "You are an enemy of the gods, Danavas and Yakshas, Gandharvas and Nagas and being a thorn in the neck of sages, I will uproot you from here."

verses.sloka: ततः स रोषताम्राक्षः शशास सचिवांस्तदा ।गृह्यतामेष दुर्मेधा वध्यतामिति चासकृत् ।। ६.४१.८२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa roṣatāmrākṣaḥ śaśāsa sacivāṁstadā ।gṛhyatāmeṣa durmedhā vadhyatāmiti cāsakṛt ।। 6.41.82 ।।।।

translations.english: "Unless you return back Vaidehi respectfully, bowing down to me you will be killed and Vibheeshana will get the fortune."

verses.sloka: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा दीप्ताग्निसमतेजसः ।जगृहुस्तं ततो घोराश्चत्वारो रजनीचराः ।। ६.४१.८३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā dīptāgnisamatejasaḥ ।jagṛhustaṁ tato ghorāścatvāro rajanīcarāḥ ।। 6.41.83 ।।।।

translations.english: The leader of the monkeys having spoken in that manner, Ravana the ruler of night rangers was overtaken by fury.

verses.sloka: ग्राहयामास तारेयः स्वयमात्मानमात्मवान् ।बलं दर्शयितुं वीरो यातुधानगणे तदा ।। ६.४१.८४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: grāhayāmāsa tāreyaḥ svayamātmānamātmavān ।balaṁ darśayituṁ vīro yātudhānagaṇe tadā ।। 6.41.84 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Ravana who was shaken by fury repeatedly commanded his ministers and said 'Let this evil minded monkey be seized and killed'.

verses.sloka: स तान् बाहुद्वये सक्तानादाय पतगानिव ।प्रासादं शैलसङ्कासमुत्पपाताङ्गदस्तदा ।। ६.४१.८५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tān bāhudvaye saktānādāya patagāniva ।prāsādaṁ śailasaṅkāsamutpapātāṅgadastadā ।। 6.41.85 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter, having heard the words of Ravana, the four Rakshasas seized Angada blazing in brilliance like fire.

verses.sloka: ते ऽन्तरिक्षाद्विनिर्धूतास्तस्य वेगेन राक्षसाः ।भूमौ निपतिताः सर्वे राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पश्यतः ।। ६.४१.८६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te 'ntarikṣādvinirdhūtāstasya vegena rākṣasāḥ ।bhūmau nipatitāḥ sarve rākṣasendrasya paśyataḥ ।। 6.41.86 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Angada, the son of Tara, on his own wanting to exhibit his strength in the presence of the Rakshasa army allowed himself to be caught.

verses.sloka: ततः प्रासादशिखरं शैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् ।ददर्श राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ।। ६.४१.८७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prāsādaśikharaṁ śailaśṛṅgamivonnatam ।dadarśa rākṣasendrasya vāliputraḥ pratāpavān ।। 6.41.87 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Angada holding the Rakshasas by his arms came down like birds on the roof of the palace which stood like a mountain.

verses.sloka: तत्पफाल पदाक्रान्तं दशग्रीवस्य पश्यतः ।पुरा हिमवतः शृङ्गं वज्रिणेव विदारितम् ।। ६.४१.८८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatpaphāla padākrāntaṁ daśagrīvasya paśyataḥ ।purā himavataḥ śṛṅgaṁ vajriṇeva vidāritam ।। 6.41.88 ।।।।

translations.english: Crushed by that speed of Angada coming down as if from the sky all the Rakshasas fell down on the ground while the Rakshasa king looked on.

verses.sloka: भङ्क्त्वा प्रासादशिखरं नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः ।विनद्य सुमहानादमुत्पपात विहायसम् ।। ६.४१.८९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhaṅktvā prāsādaśikharaṁ nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ ।vinadya sumahānādamutpapāta vihāyasam ।। 6.41.89 ।।।।

translations.english: Then as the courageous Vali's son landed on the high peak of the palace which resembled a mountain peak, Ravana stood looking.

verses.sloka: व्यथयन् राक्षसान् सर्वान् हर्षयंश्चापि वानरान् ।स वानराणां मध्ये तु रामपार्श्वमुपागतः ।। ६.४१.९० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vyathayan rākṣasān sarvān harṣayaṁścāpi vānarān ।sa vānarāṇāṁ madhye tu rāmapārśvamupāgataḥ ।। 6.41.90 ।।।।

translations.english: As Ravana was looking, Angada trampling his feet gave way to the palace just as Himalayan peak broke to hit Indra.

verses.sloka: रावणस्तु परं चक्रे क्रोधं प्रासादधर्षणात् ।विनाशं चात्मनः पश्यन्निश्वासपरमो ऽभवत् ।। ६.४१.९१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇastu paraṁ cakre krodhaṁ prāsādadharṣaṇāt ।vināśaṁ cātmanaḥ paśyanniśvāsaparamo 'bhavat ।। 6.41.91 ।।।।

translations.english: Hitting on the peak of the palace, Angada declaring his own name emitting loud sound rose up to the sky.

verses.sloka: रामस्तु बहुभिर्हृष्टैर्निनदद्भिः प्लवङ्गमैः ।वृतो रिपुवधाकाङ्क्षी युद्धायैवाभ्यवर्तत ।। ६.४१.९२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāmastu bahubhirhṛṣṭairninadadbhiḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ ।vṛto ripuvadhākāṅkṣī yuddhāyaivābhyavartata ।। 6.41.92 ।।।।

translations.english: Angada caused pain to the Rakshasas and delighted the monkeys and returned to the midst of Vanaras near Rama.

verses.sloka: सुषेणस्तु महावीर्यो गिरिकूटोपमो हरिः ।बहुभिः संवृतस्तत्र वानरैः कामरूपिभिः ।। ६.४१.९३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: suṣeṇastu mahāvīryo girikūṭopamo hariḥ ।bahubhiḥ saṁvṛtastatra vānaraiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ ।। 6.41.93 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana exhibiting extreme anger at the shattering of his palace and seeing his destruction started sighing heavily.

verses.sloka: चतुर्द्वाराणि सर्वाणि सुग्रीववचनात् कपिः ।पर्यक्रामत दुर्धर्षो नक्षत्राणीव चन्द्रमाः ।। ६.४१.९४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: caturdvārāṇi sarvāṇi sugrīvavacanāt kapiḥ ।paryakrāmata durdharṣo nakṣatrāṇīva candramāḥ ।। 6.41.94 ।।।।

translations.english: Delighted by the roaring sound of many monkeys Rama awaited surrounded by groups of monkeys desirous of starting war.

verses.sloka: तेषामक्षौहिणिशतं समवेक्ष्य वनौकसाम् ।लङ्कामुपनिविष्टानां सागरं चाभिवर्तताम् ।। ६.४१.९५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāmakṣauhiṇiśataṁ samavekṣya vanaukasām ।laṅkāmupaniviṣṭānāṁ sāgaraṁ cābhivartatām ।। 6.41.95 ।।।।

translations.english: Sushena of great prowess, who resembled a mountain in form stood there surrounded by many Vanaras who could change their form at their will.

verses.sloka: राक्षसा विस्मयं जग्मुस्त्रासं जग्मुस्तथा ऽपरे ।अपरे समरोद्धर्षाद्धर्षमेव प्रपेदिरे ।। ६.४१.९६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasā vismayaṁ jagmustrāsaṁ jagmustathā 'pare ।apare samaroddharṣāddharṣameva prapedire ।। 6.41.96 ।।।।

translations.english: Sushena, a monkey who is difficult to encounter, went around all the four gates just like the moon goes around stars by the order of Sugriva.

verses.sloka: कृत्स्नं हि कपिभिर्व्याप्तं प्राकारपरिखान्तरम् ।ददृशू राक्षसा दीनाः प्राकारं वानरीकृतम् ।। ६.४१.९७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kṛtsnaṁ hi kapibhirvyāptaṁ prākāraparikhāntaram ।dadṛśū rākṣasā dīnāḥ prākāraṁ vānarīkṛtam ।। 6.41.97 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the large army of a hundred Akshauhinis of monkeys staying near Lanka spreading beyond the sea waiting for war the Rakshasas were wonder struck, some feared, some were alarmed to witness the jubilant Vanaras who exhibited joy alone.

verses.sloka: हाहाकारं प्रकुर्वन्ति राक्षसा भयमोहिताः ।। ६.४१.९८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hāhākāraṁ prakurvanti rākṣasā bhayamohitāḥ ।। 6.41.98 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the large army of a hundred Akshauhinis of monkeys staying near Lanka spreading beyond the sea waiting for war the Rakshasas were wonder struck, some feared, some were alarmed to witness the jubilant Vanaras who exhibited joy alone.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् महाभीषणके प्रवृत्ते कोलाहले राक्षसराजधान्याम् ।प्रगृह्य रक्षांसि महायुधानि युगान्तवाता इव संविचेरुः ।। ६.४१.९९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin mahābhīṣaṇake pravṛtte kolāhale rākṣasarājadhānyām ।pragṛhya rakṣāṁsi mahāyudhāni yugāntavātā iva saṁviceruḥ ।। 6.41.99 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas were desperate to see the spread of monkeys over the entire area from the boundary to moat of Lanka. The way the space between was filled with Vanaras seemed as though the Vanaras converted into boundaries. Rakshasas were seen making a loud noise.
